purpose: Exploratory reduced-model accuracy comparison retaining the hard tariff
extra_actions: zero, import zero, fee crossing with verified sides, bounds, and next-SoC interpolation knots
exogenous_transition: Gaussian exact OU step then reflection; integrate linear load-grid basis functions analytically
soc_transition: exact held action with linear interpolation of continuation values
terminal_cost: exact quadratic evaluated analytically at the final action
selection_rule: sequential expected hard-cost improvement of at least 0.10 EUR/day; checkpoint within seed, then seed against zero-action fallback
heuristic_selection: same 96 reserve/recharge/price/switch settings, selected on the selection-grid expected hard cost
boundary_regret: Q_DP(x,a_policy)-V_DP(x), for states where the DP action's grid import is within 10 kW of the fee boundary
selection_scope: model-based selection and evaluation, separate from historical test inference
